name: statements
note: Keyword-led alternatives, a repetition at the end of the root and a nested reference.

name: annotated
note: The same grammar with @autoCommit on one rule: only that rule is rewritten; the lint reports both.

name: overlap
note: Overlapping FIRST sets: the first alternative is not reported, the last one is.

name: enclosing-choice
note: Locally cut-safe, but the enclosing choice resumes at the same position: 'ay' is accepted only by backtracking out of Item.

name: optional-follow
note: An optional absorbs the failure and its continuation starts with the same code point; a different site of the rule is still reported.

name: optional-follow-disjoint
note: The continuation after the optional cannot start with 'a'.

name: block
note: A repetition closed by a terminal, with a recursive alternative.

name: one-or-more
note: After a repetition the continuation starts like the item: 'abac' is accepted only by ending the repetition.

name: separated
note: A separated list followed by a closing terminal.

name: separated-trailing
note: The list may end before a separator that the continuation also accepts (conservative).

name: whitespace
note: Automatic whitespace makes the analysis inapplicable to the whole grammar.

name: rule-whitespace
note: A rule-level whitespace annotation also disables the grammar.

name: raising-and-labels
note: An alternative followed by a raising operator is not reported, and nothing inside COMMIT, LABEL or CATCH is.

name: capture
note: Owned captures and replays are not modelled.

name: opaque-rules
note: A longest choice is opaque: nothing inside it is reported and a walk that reaches it stops; unreachable rules are not reported.

name: recovery
note: A recovery rule is opaque.

name: tokens
note: Declarative tokens (with references and CHAR_RANGE) are modelled exactly in ASCII.

name: tokens-unknown
note: LOOKAHEAD and CI tokens are not modelled: alternatives before them are not reported, alternatives after them are.

name: token-range
note: A CHAR_RANGE token disjoint from the other alternatives, and a token reference that is wrapped.

name: parameterized
note: Commits are found after parameterized rules are expanded; instances are wrapped by their expanded name.

name: left-recursion
note: A left-recursive grammar is not analysed.

name: two-roots
note: Exactly one root is required.

name: non-ascii
note: Code points above ASCII share one flag, so two non-ASCII alternatives overlap.
